stories.title: Three main accused in Goa nightclub fire surrender before Mapusa court two weeks after SC order

en.title: Three main accused in Goa nightclub fire surrender before Mapusa court two weeks after SC order
en.summary: Three main accused in a December 6, 2025 nightclub fire in North Goa that killed 25 people have surrendered to court following a Supreme Court directive. The fire at Birch by Romeo Lane nightclub in Arpora resulted in multiple deaths and injuries.

en.title: Pakistan's Damage Control With Saudi After Backtracking On Houthi Fight
en.summary: Pakistan's leadership is conducting damage control with Saudi Arabia after reversing its position on engagement in conflict with Houthi forces. The Pakistani leader has reaffirmed solidarity with the Saudi government.

en.title: Former Tehelka editor Tarun Tejpal surrenders before Goa Court; sent to jail to serve 10-year sentence
en.summary: Former Tehelka editor Tarun Tejpal has surrendered to court in Goa and been sent to jail to serve a 10-year prison sentence. His surrender follows a Supreme Court order and a conviction by the Bombay High Court.

en.title: Asia Cup 2026: Indian women's cricket team refuse trophy from Pakistan's Mohsin Naqvi

stories.title: Why can’t NSE trade on its own platform after the IPO, and is it a big deal?

en.title: Why can't NSE trade on its own platform after the IPO, and is it a big deal?
en.summary: NSE will not seek Sebi approval to list on its own platform, as regulations require recognised exchanges to list on another exchange. NSE's upcoming IPO is therefore expected to result in a BSE-only listing.
